messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: HIGH error rate - api.redwood.ai TLS handshake failures across edge LB (target-group: tg-api-us). Alert triggered at 2026-03-15T02:15:23Z

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident#PD-3241 created and paging group 'sre-oncall'. Escalation level 1.

maya (oncall): Acked. I’m on it, paging SRE. Starting triage.

sam (sre): I’m looking. Can you confirm region/scale? Any deploys in the last 30m?

deploy-bot: deploy: service/api v2026.3.15-87b2 deployed to us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T02:05:10Z by lex.

maya (oncall): saw that deploy. Error graphs show TLS errors spike ~02:08UTC. 90% of 5xx are TLS handshake failures.

sam (sre): Running quick curl against LB ip to reproduce: 
```
$ curl -v --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:52.14.23.101 https://api.redwood.ai/health
* Rebuilt URL to: https://api.redwood.ai/health
*   Trying 52.14.23.101...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (52.14.23.101) port 443 (#0)
* ALPN, offering http/1.1
* SSL connection using TLS1.3 / TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
* TLS handshake had read error
* error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unknown ca
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) SSL connect error
```

sam (sre): LB health shows targets marked UNHEALTHY with reason 'TLS handshake failed'.

maya (oncall): Checking target details: instance ids i-0a1b2c3d in tg-api-us show cert CN=api.redwood.internal (internal cert), looks wrong.

lex (prod-ops): I rotated certs in the deploy yesterday, but that was for internal sidecars only. Not supposed to affect public LB. Did the deploy include an nginx config change?

deploy-bot: config-change: nginx-proxy updated by lex in v2026.3.15-87b2. Diff: replaced cert path /etc/ssl/certs/prod.pem -> /etc/ssl/certs/internal.pem for rollout testing.

jordan (sre): Oh. That explains handshake failures — public clients get an internal cert (unknown CA). Targets will fail health checks and LB marks them unhealthy; DNS may still point to the same LB though.

maya (oncall): Impact: ~30% requests failing globally, higher in EU. CS reporting multiple customers with 502/TLS errors.

cs-ops: Multiple incoming tickets: large enterprise customer 'Pinpoint' reporting intermittent auth failures and TLS errors since 02:10UTC. They asked if this is a cert rotation.

sam (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) remove bad cert from nginx on targets and restore prod cert, 2) force target re-register to LB, 3) if that fails, fail traffic to standby region and scale up. Will attempt 1 now.

maya (oncall): I’m sshing to one of the unhealthy targets and rolling prod cert back. Command: 
```
sudo cp /etc/ssl/certs/prod.pem /etc/nginx/certs/prod.pem && sudo systemctl reload nginx
```

sam (sre): I see reloads. Checking health endpoint logs on i-0a1b2c3d: 
```
[02:16:58Z] nginx: SSL_do_handshake() failed: alert unknown ca
[02:17:01Z] health check failed, returning 502
```

lex (prod-ops): I’m patching the deploy config to remove the accidental cert path change, pushing a hotfix config to fleet.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Maya acknowledged. Escalation paused.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by maya (oncall) at 2026-03-15T02:18:10Z.

jordan (sre): If rollback finishes and LB sees healthy targets, we should see recovery within the next 60-120s for that LB. Also verifying DNS — TTL was 60s, but CDN caches could still route to other edge nodes.

maya (oncall): After prod cert restore, LB target health flipped to healthy for 6/8 hosts. Still seeing some errors from eu-edge nodes (cached routes).

sam (sre): For remaining eu-edge failures, I’m triggering a failover to our standby ELB in eu-west-1 to reduce customer impact while caches expire. Command: 
```
aws elb set-load-balancer-policies-for-backend-server --load-balancer-name lb-eu --instance-ports 443 --policy-names failover-policy
```

lex (prod-ops): Initiating traffic shift to standby region (eu-west-1) with canary 10% -> 100% over 5m. Also invalidating CDN edge cert cache.

cs-ops: Notifying customers: "We are aware of TLS/connectivity issues affecting API access. We have identified a cert configuration regression after a recent deploy and are rolling back. Full mitigation underway. ETA ~10–20 minutes."

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident[PD-3241] status changed: acknowledged -> in_progress.

incident-bot: Auto-note: created incident ticket IN-2026-198 for tracking and postmortem.

maya (oncall): After rollback + failover, error rate down from 30% -> 2% over last 5m. Monitoring for residual TLS errors.

jordan (sre): Confirmed EU traffic now hitting standby with healthy certs. Still need to ensure config fix is in CI to prevent re-deploy.

sam (sre): Also checked DNS: we had recently increased ALIAS TTL to 300s during a perf test, which slowed propagation of corrected endpoints. Not root cause but slowed recovery for some customers hitting cached old endpoints. Note for follow-up: avoid TTL bump during deploy windows.

lex (prod-ops): Root cause summary (preliminary): accidental cert path change in nginx proxy during v2026.3.15 deploy caused public edge to present internal cert -> TLS handshake failures -> LB target health degraded. Secondary factor: high DNS/edge cache TTL slowed client re-routing to fixed endpoints.

cs-ops: We’ll keep customers updated with the status and send a summary once incident is closed.

maya (oncall): PagerDuty: I’m resolving my ack in 30m and handing off to jordan for postmortem and follow-up. Creating the incident channel #incident-pd-3241 and adding owners.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: maya (oncall) changed incident owner to jordan (sre) at 2026-03-15T02:45:33Z.

jordan (sre): I’ll own the post-incident: collecting logs, timelines, and proposed corrective actions (CI guardrail for config diffs, deploy-time cert validation, and TTL deployment guidance).

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation applied (rollback cert + regional failover). Service recovery observed at 02:24:40Z. Closing pagerduty escalation window.

maya (oncall): :white_check_mark: monitoring looks stable. Incident moved to monitoring phase. Will update the ticket and stand down primary paging unless it regresses.

cs-ops: Patch note to customers drafted. Will send once final postmortem outline exists.

jordan (sre): Next steps (action items): [1] CI check to diff cert paths and fail deploy on non-prod certs in prod path, [2] add pre-deploy cert validation against CA store, [3] document TTL change playbook for prod DNS, [4] postmortem + RCA. I’ll pick these up and assign.

maya (oncall): Handing off. Good job team.

deploy-bot: deploy: hotfix v2026.3.15-87b2-hotfix applied to nginx-proxy config at 2026-03-15T02:22:12Z by lex.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-3241 moved to monitoring at 2026-03-15T02:30:00Z.

incident-bot: Automated summary: PD-3241 - TLS handshake failures due to incorrect cert in deploy -> rollback + failover -> recovery. Postmortem ticket IN-2026-198 created.

jordan (sre): Will follow up with a rough timeline and attach logs to the postmortem doc. Leaving this thread for async updates.

maya (oncall): last check-in: 02:50UTC. Leaving on-call notes in the ticket. Handoff complete.
